block.industrial_read.model.title: Industrial Read
block.industrial_read.model.description: Read allowlisted Modbus TCP or OPC UA points with calibration, quality and explicit stale-value invalidation; no equipment writes.
block.industrial_read.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.industrial_read.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.industrial_read.workflow: Read configured points only. Values become unknown after an error or expiry; this block never commands equipment.
block.industrial_read.help_enabled: Off by default. Prepare never connects; only Play in periodic mode or an explicit read opens the connection.
block.industrial_read.help_protocol: Changing protocol also requires adapting the point definitions before Apply.
block.industrial_read.help_start_mode: On command waits for read/start. Periodic begins at Play in Active Runtime only.
block.industrial_read.help_endpoint: Modbus: tcp://host:502. OPC UA: opc.tcp://host:4840/path. Explicit port, no credentials or discovery.
block.industrial_read.help_allow_insecur: Required for Modbus TCP and OPC UA without security. Use only an explicitly trusted equipment network.
block.industrial_read.help_unit_id: 1–255. Broadcast unit 0 is refused. Register addresses are zero-based offsets.
block.industrial_read.help_opcua_securit: Sign and encrypt uses Basic256Sha256 with an exact pinned server certificate. No silent downgrade.
block.industrial_read.help_credential_re: Secure OPC UA: wallet JSON with certificate_pem/private_key_pem and optional username/password. Clear this reference before selecting unencrypted access. Never paste private keys here.
block.industrial_read.help_server_certif: Paste the exact public certificate, not a private key. Certificate changes require review and a new Run.
block.industrial_read.help_points: Array: Modbus {"id":"temp","area":"holding","address":0,"type":"uint16","scale":0.1,"unit":"C"}; OPC UA {"id":"temp","node_id":"ns=2;s=Temp","type":"float64","unit":"C"}. At most 64 points.
block.industrial_read.help_interval_ms: Bounds periodic and explicit reads; one request at a time, no catch-up burst.
block.industrial_read.help_connect_timeo: A stuck resolver or protocol handshake is terminated in the owned process.
block.industrial_read.help_read_timeout_: Total deadline for all selected points, not a fresh allowance per register.
block.industrial_read.help_stale_after_m: Emit null with stale quality when a point is not successfully refreshed. Stop/disconnect also invalidates observations.
block.industrial_read.help_reconnect_att: Only periodic acquisition retries; finite budget until an explicit start. No hidden SDK retries.
block.industrial_read.help_reconnect_del: Fixed minimum pause between failed connection attempts.
block.industrial_read.help_max_measureme: Stop acquisition at the limit. A new Run is required to reset the count.
block.industrial_read.help_application_u: Must match a URI in the client certificate SAN; default urn:hackinvent:bloxsmith:industrial-read.
block.industrial_read.help_source_max_ag: Reject old source timestamps even when a new network response arrives. Adjust for the device’s timestamp semantics.
block.industrial_read.help_max_clock_ske: A source timestamp too far in the future is unknown, not fresh.
block.industrial_read.help_require_sourc: Missing source time invalidates the value. Modbus has no native sample timestamp and reports its age as unknown.
